rows.transcript_gb_en_m:
Here is something fun to help you let go of stress:   

Choose a song that reflects what you need in this moment. Do you need a gentle song to soothe your tired soul or an upbeat song to help you shake some stress out?   

Make a space and move your body to the music. Remember to breathe while you move. Let your breath and the movement go together. 

Even a few minutes of movement can be enough to release stress and lift your mood!
rows.transcript_my_ms_m:
Berikut adalah sesuatu yang menyeronokkan untuk membantu anda melepaskan tekanan:

Pilih sebuah lagu yang sesuai dengan apa yang anda perlukan saat ini. Adakah anda perlukan lagu yang lembut dan perlahan untuk menenangkan jiwa yang letih, atau lagu yang rancak untuk membantu anda rasa bertenaga dan keluarkan rasa tertekan anda?

Cari ruang dan gerakkan tubuh anda mengikut irama. Ingat untuk terus bernafas semasa anda bergerak. Biarkan nafas dan pergerakan anda selari.

Pergerakan selama beberapa minit pun sudah cukup untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menceriakan mood anda!

text_1_facilitator.eng:
Once your child knows about numbers and groups of things, they can start learning more number skills⭐

Remember to go slowly and have fun with things that your child can nearly do! 😃

4️⃣ Here are four ways for you to encourage your child to practise his number skills:

section_1_text.eng:
🌱 Ask your child to help sort things into groups, such as putting all the leaves together when cooking. 
😃 Ask your child to find 5 of something, like sticks, and then to order them from smallest to biggest. ⬆️ Then order them a different way, like from lightest to darkest! 
✨ Help your child think about groups! Say: “A potato is a round red vegetable. Can you think of something else that is red like a potato?” Then: “Can you think of something that is also round but bigger than a potato?” ⚽

section_2_text.eng:
⬆️⬇️ Once they know about numbers, your child might be able to start learning about adding and taking away!
🍚 Use activities similar to counting exercises, like cooking, sorting clothes, shopping, or building things!
🍅 Let’s start by adding. Say: “I have two potatoes. When I add two more, how many do I have?” Help your child get the answer! Keep practising and, after a while, make it more difficult!

⬇️ Repeat the activity, but take things away: “I have five potatoes. When I take two away, how many do I have?”
🔄 Practise anywhere and everywhere! You can use different things like balls or shoes. You can also do the game in your imaginations.

section_3_text.eng:
⏰ Once your child has learned some number skills, they can start learning harder skills.
5️⃣ If you think they are ready, ask them to find 5 stones. Show them that you can make 5 stones with one group of 1 stone and another of 4 stones; then show them with one group of 2 and one group of 3.
🔟 When they are ready, do the same activity with bigger numbers - up to 10 stones.

section_4_text.eng:
💚 Go slowly and help your child build confidence by doing things they are ready for and know how to do. 
😃 Always encourage their effort and praise them. Mistakes are okay, too!
🎉 Keep learning fun. It helps them stay excited and motivated!
